official_access.access_mode: Discover accessions through the official BioModels/BioStudies APIs, resolve each accession's file inventory, and transfer model files through the official HTTP/FTP/Aspera surfaces rather than scraping model pages.
official_access.transition_note: BioModels moved from EMBL-EBI to the University of Florida in 2025. biomodels.org is the live service; EMBL-EBI retains the BioStudies archival collection as a reproducible bulk-access surface.

scope.corpus: Published and archived mathematical/computational models of biological and biomedical systems represented in SBML and related standard formats
structures: event triggers, delays, priorities and assignments
other explicit MathML expressions carried by SBML models
scope.original_representation: exact lexical MathML <math> element as stored in the SBML source file
scope.batching: one verified BioModels inventory snapshot per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: Do not derive ODEs from reaction networks in the extracted stage
Do not turn a kinetic law plus stoichiometry into a reconstructed differential equation in this lane
Do not OCR PDFs or figures when SBML MathML is available
Do not silently substitute a converted/exported representation for the archived source file without recording that representation as a distinct source object

snapshot_policy.rule: Enumerate the official BioModels corpus through the live API or the EMBL-EBI BioStudies archival collection, resolve the exact files for each accession, retain the API/export metadata used for discovery, SHA-256 every acquired source object, build a deterministic sorted inventory, and use biomodels:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. A changed accession set, file set, or byte inventory is a new immutable snapshot/item.

license_policy.rule: BioModels states that hosted models are freely available for use, modification and redistribution under CC0. Preserve accession and model/file provenance even though attribution is not a CC0 condition. If an acquired object carries a conflicting explicit rights notice or is not a BioModels-hosted model encoding, fail closed for that object and record the audit debt instead of inheriting CC0 by association.

adapter.input: one SBML file or a directory tree of BioModels SBML/XML files whose paths contain BIOMD########## or MODEL########## accessions
validation: XML parser and lexical scanner must agree on the number and order of MathML <math> elements in each accepted file
expression_original is the exact lexical MathML substring from the source XML, preserving entities, namespaces and spacing
source_record_sha256 is independent of the executor's local directory and depends on accession, snapshot, document bytes, MathML ordinal, semantic parent and expression bytes
SBML level/version, model id/name, semantic parent, target symbol, explicit target units when present, reaction/event/function identifiers and document checksum are retained
No OCR, ODE reconstruction, symbolic equivalence or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
